convert_module_to_f16: convert a PyTorch module's parameters to float16 for memory-efficient training
convert_module_to_f32: convert a PyTorch module's parameters back to float32 from float16
zero_module: zero out all parameters of a PyTorch module and return it
scale_module: scale all parameters of a PyTorch module by a given factor
modulate: apply shift and scale modulation to a tensor using element-wise operations
